verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents getting and provisioning numbers: organizations can deploy and manage phone numbers at scale, a Voice admin can assign numbers, each employee gets a phone number, and a certified local carrier can supply numbers. None of the evidence shows searching available numbers by area code, a self-serve purchase flow, or how fast a local number becomes active. The rest of the number evidence is about porting existing numbers, not acquiring new ones. missing for 10: area-code search of available numbers, documented self-serve purchase/selection flow, evidence of minutes-level provisioning time, independent or hands-on corroboration.
